Phase posture — harden vs build.question: How should Phase 2 treat the existing canonical core?
Phase posture — harden vs build.answer: Evidence-driven harden — map each of the 5 success criteria to existing code + at least one repeatable check; implement only missing behavior or weak evidence (mirrors Phase 1 D-01).

Phase posture — harden vs build.question: Which authority governs scope and evidence for this phase?
Phase posture — harden vs build.answer: Legacy docs as evidence — docs/03-plan phase-1 board, specs/005·006·012·015·016·019, ADR-0101…0114 as authoritative evidence/reference; .planning/ROADMAP.md stays the phase contract.

Phase posture — harden vs build.question: How do the owner-gated blockers affect Phase 2 completion?
Phase posture — harden vs build.answer: Fixture-complete, record gates — Phase 2 can complete on the synthetic fixture; OD-01/OD-02/OD-03 recorded as explicit blocked/deferred gates that block REAL canonical activation, never a silent pass.

Phase posture — harden vs build.question: Is translation-edition work in Phase 2 scope?
Phase posture — harden vs build.answer: Translations IN scope — model/validate translation editions as a distinct non-canonical layer (translator NOT NULL, aligned edition, own hash, no path into canonical slot), exercised on synthetic data (ADR-0112).

Canonical dataset & bundle policy.question: Bundle policy for the canonical edition (ADR-0101 Options A/B/C)?
Canonical dataset & bundle policy.answer: B — fixture + user import — ship no real canonical text; engineering runs on synthetic test-edition-min, operator imports an approved edition via `qai quran import`.

Canonical dataset & bundle policy.question: Should Phase 2 pin a concrete canonical edition identity, or keep it owner-gated?
Canonical dataset & bundle policy.answer: Leave identity owner-gated — do not invent an upstream slug/publisher/license; record exact upstream_edition_slug and license as pending owner gates (OD-01).

Canonical dataset & bundle policy.question: How is the primary/default edition designation represented?
Canonical dataset & bundle policy.answer: Explicit primary/default flag (Uthmani + Hafs 'an Asim) feeding the existing quran_active_edition singleton.

Canonical dataset & bundle policy.question: What synthetic dataset posture should the phase plan against?
Canonical dataset & bundle policy.answer: Add a richer synthetic fixture — larger synthetic edition (more surahs/ayahs, basmala variants, multi-token ayahs, division boundaries) to exercise integrity checks more deeply.
